data.text: I’ll join you: 15 tons this month, with all $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, provided Jack commits too and we deliver the full $60,000 today. Our neighbors need treatment, and we can meet that need without making this harvest our new normal. I’ll take no more than 6 tons next month under the combined 30-ton cap, then return to 10 tons each once the lake recovers to 100. Luke’s zero catch this month is part of that agreement. Jack, are you willing to join us?
